Cholesterol (KEGG:C00187) is the primary cross-paradigm driver, appearing as a hit in both RaMP and Mummichog across multiple sterol-related pathways. 4-Pyridoxic acid (KEGG:C00847) independently supports Vitamin B6 metabolism (MetaboAnalystR hsa00750, rank 1, p=0.0224) and overlaps with the broader RaMP vitamin/cofactor metabolism hit. Coumarin (KEGG:C05851) anchors the xenobiotic metabolism signal in Mummichog (rank 3). Uric acid (KEGG:C00366) appears in RaMP Metabolism and Transport of small molecules but is not a primary driver in this enrichment context. The convergent sterol/xenobiotic signature is consistent with exposure to polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon toxicants affecting hepatic Phase I enzyme capacity.
